title: 45 Hindi Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Hindi for Beginners (Agreeing & Disagreeing)
description:
Learn 45 essential Hindi phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Hindi #LearnHindi #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in हिन्दी, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Hindi with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 45 real-life phrases
- हिन्दी audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

PHRASE LIST

AGREEING & DISAGREEING · सहमत होना और असहमत होना
• You might be right, but not convinced. - तुम्हारा बात सही हो सकता है, पर मैं पूरी तरह नहीं मान रहा।  [Tumhāri bāt sahi ho sakti hai, par main POORI tarah nahin mān rahā।]
• I agree, yet I need evidence. - मैं सहमत हूँ, लेकिन मुझे सबूत चाहिए।  [Main sahमत हूँ, lekin mujhe SABOOT chāhiye।]
• That could work, I still disagree. - ये चल सकता है, फिर भी मैं असहमत हूँ।  [Ye chal sakta hai, phir bhi main ASHahmat hoon।]
• I see your point, but no. - मैं समझ रहा हूँ, लेकिन नहीं।  [Main samajh rahā hoon, lekin nahin।]
• I’m on board, just not fully yet. - मैं साथ हूँ, बस अभी पूरी तरह नहीं।  [Main sāth hoon, bas abhi POORI tarah nahin।]

COFFEE SHOP & BAKERY · कॉफी शॉप और बेकरी
• Hi, can I try your cinnamon roll? - नमस्ते, क्या मैं आपका सिनेमन रोल ट्राय कर सकती हूँ?  [Namaste, kya MAIN aapka cinnamon ROLL try kar sakti HOON?]
• Do you have any gluten-free treats? - क्या आपके यहाँ कोई ग्लूटेन-फ्री ट्रीट्स हैं?  [Kya aapke yahan koi gluten-FREE TREATS hain?]
• I want a small latte, please. - मुझे एक छोटा लट्टे चाहिए, कृपया।  [Mujhe ek chhota latte CHAHIYE, kripya.]
• Can I get oat milk in it? - क्या इसमें ओट मिल्क मिल सकता है?  [Kya isme oat milk MIL sakta hai?]
• What pastry is warm right now? - अभी कौन-सी पेस्ट्री गर्म है?  [Abhi kaun-si PASTRY GARm hai?]
• I’ll take two cookies for later. - मैं बाद के लिए दो कुकीज़ ले लूँगा  [Main baad ke liye do cookies le LUNGA/LUNGI.]

MAKING PLANS · योजनाएँ बनाना
• I need to line up next week. - Mujhe agle hafte ka schedule set karna hai.  [Mujhe AGle hafte ka SCHEDule set KARna hai]
• Let s decide the budget first. - Pehle humein budget tay karna chahiye.  [PEHle humein BUDget tay KARna chahiye]
• Should we meet at a café? - Kya hum café mein mil sakte hain?  [Kya hum CAFE mein mil sakte hain]
• I ll send options by evening. - Main shaam tak options bhej dunga.  [Main SHAAM tak OPshonz bhej dunga]
• Can we pencil this in for Friday? - Kya hum isey shukravaar ko tentative rakh sakte hain?  [Kya hum isey shukravaar ko TEN-tuh-tiv rakh sakte hain]
• What s our best time to start? - Start karne ka sabse sahi samay kya hoga?  [START KARne ka SABse sahi SAMay kya hoga]

JOY · आनंद
• My stress drops the moment I exhale. - साँस छोड़ते ही मेरा तनाव कम हो जाता है।  [Saans chhoDte hi MERA tanAv kam ho jaata hai.]
• I feel joy in simple chores. - साधारण कामों में भी मुझे आनंद मिलता है।  [SaaDhaaran kaamon mein bhi MUJHE aanand miLta hai.]
• Walking outside clears my head, instantly. - बाहर टहलते ही मेरा दिमाग साफ हो जाता है।  [Baahar tahalte hi mera DIMAAG saaf ho jaata hai.]
• That warm call woke something happy in me. - उस गर्मजोशी भरी कॉल ने मुझे खुश कर दिया।  [Us garamjoShi bhari call NE MUJHE khush kar diya.]
• I’m smiling for no big reason. - मैं किसी बड़ी वजह के बिना भी मुस्कुरा रहा हूँ।  [Main kisi biDĐi vajah ke BINA bhi muskura raha hoon.]

COMMON NATIVE SLANG · आम स्थानीय बोलचाल
• Bro, chai is on me. - Yaar, chai main pilata hoon.  [YAAR, chai MAIN pilaata hoon.]
• You got time for a quick call? - Tujhe abhi ek minute ka call time hai?  [tujhe ABHI ek MINUTE ka CALL time hai?]
• Come on, hurry up, please. - Arre, jaldi kar na, please.  [ARRE, jaldi KAR na, PLEASE.]
• I’m totally down for that plan. - Main bilkul us plan ke liye ready hoon.  [MAIN bilkul us PLAN ke liye READY hoon.]
• That’s a joke, right? - Haan bhai, mazaak kar rahe ho na?  [haan BHAI, MAZAAK kar rahe ho na?]
• Don’t beat around the bush. - Seedha seedha bolo, baat kya hai?  [SEEDHA SEEDHA bolo, baat KYA hai?]

ASKING FOR DIRECTIONS · रास्ता पूछना
• How do I reach the library? - मैं लाइब्रेरी कैसे पहुँचूँ?  [Main laaibreri kaise pahunchoon?]
• Is there a landmark nearby? - क्या पास में कोई पहचानने वाला लैंडमार्क है?  [Kya paas mein koi pahchaanne wala LANDMARK hai?]
• Can you point me to the bridge? - क्या आप मुझे पुल की तरफ दिखा सकते हैं?  [Kya aap mujhe pul ki taraf dikha sakte hain?]
• Where is the entrance from here? - यहाँ से अंदर का एंट्रेंस कहाँ है?  [Yahaan se andar ka ENTRENCE kahaan hai?]
